_note: Authored catalogue words for each design (ADR 0156): description, slug, industries, occasions, style, colour, family, aliases. Industries, occasions, style and colour were seeded from names, setups, collections and tokens on 2026-10-20 and need review; descriptions are written by the design author. Labels live in taxonomy, never in the plugin.

campaign-streetwear-poster.description: A full-width condensed masthead sits above a fashion photograph and a narrow offer column. The lime footer reads like a drop announcement.

campaign-tech-price-sheet.description: A broad product photograph is captioned by a compact price ledger. The offer feels like a product launch sheet, with the saving in its own bold block.

campaign-fifty-fifty-poster.description: The discount is the composition: a giant 50 above a compact contrasting Black Friday strip and a tightly grouped action.

campaign-black-friday-coffee-menu.description: A narrow café-menu composition pairs a framed coffee photograph with a menu-style offer line, generous spacing and a full-width order button.

campaign-first-access-pass.description: A horizontal access pass puts the opening date on a slim ticket stub and the signup in a wide dark panel, with the saving in a small top band.

campaign-restock-mosaic.description: Three sharply cropped product windows form a retail shelf. A full-width headline and oversized saving sit beneath, instead of a conventional photo/text split.

campaign-golden-weekend-ticket.description: A horizontal ticket gives the oversized saving its own black panel and the public code a gold redemption stub. A restrained perforation makes the offer tangible.

campaign-finish-line-countdown.description: A wide sports photograph and a compact headline occupy the main pane while a tall countdown rail turns the deadline into the composition.

campaign-sound-circle.description: A circular audio photograph is framed by short headline blocks and a slim offer footer. The product silhouette becomes the central visual anchor.

campaign-layer-edit.description: A portrait strip beside a small offer creates a horizontal slide-in rather than another tall photo card. The action spans the entire bottom edge.

campaign-black-friday-plus-one.description: A full-width headline leads to a framed product image and a large plus sign beside the gift threshold. The arrangement reads as an offer equation.

campaign-savings-staircase.description: Three rising panels turn spend-and-save thresholds into a literal staircase. Product thumbnails give each tier a tactile retail context.

campaign-twelve-month-deal.description: Twelve compact month tiles make the annual plan tangible. A large headline and full-width price dock replace the familiar two-panel pricing card.

campaign-drop-alert.description: A compact signup starts with an enormous outlined saving and a small date label, then shifts to a straightforward form. No photo block or split layout.

campaign-deadline-scoreboard.description: A narrow event strip stacks an oversized sale message over a scoreboard-style deadline row. The timer and action remain grouped.

campaign-first-dibs-signup.description: An acid-lime date block anchors a compact dark signup strip. Offer copy, email, consent and action stay in a clear horizontal rhythm.

campaign-free-delivery-label.description: A shipping-label composition uses a white barcode panel, a large zero-delivery charge and a clear threshold. Black framing keeps it firmly in the event.

campaign-extra-ten-coupon.description: A compact shoe photo leads straight into a giant extra-saving numeral, followed by a narrow contrasting code stub. This is a coupon, not a generic reminder card.

campaign-home-edit.description: A wide home campaign combines a tall furniture photograph, a compact numbered editorial column and a separate bold saving panel. Three different rhythms in one inline design.

campaign-black-friday-department.description: A full-width masthead tops three product departments, followed by one oversized offer and a direct action. A storewide takeover with a genuinely different silhouette.

campaign-welcome-perk.description: Welcome coupon. split(panel, media), code and link button. Dispenser is one static image.

campaign-friday-coupon.description: Public discount code. split of panels.

campaign-turn-it-up.description: Audio sale. media background plus panel.

campaign-friday-comic.description: Selected-items sale. stack with split panels and a footer row. Face is an image.

campaign-savings-receipt.description: Clearance sale. stack with rows, dividers, heading, text and button. Receipt tear edge and eyes are optional artwork..

campaign-welcome-shortcut.description: First-order coupon. split(panel, panel), code and button. Portal rings simplify to nested panels or one image. Hidden door/reveal interaction removed..

campaign-midnight-fragrance-edit.description: Fragrance sale. split plus footer row.

campaign-wishlist-alert.description: Early-access email signup. stack of panels and form.

campaign-garden-edit.description: Garden seasonal sale. split(image, panel), heading, text and button. Flowers are one decorative SVG image.

campaign-friday-pass.description: Early-access email signup. split of panels.

campaign-delivery-buddy.description: Shipping threshold. media background with wash, panel, heading, text, button. Robot art is one image.

campaign-black-friday-archive.description: Archive clearance. stack and split of panels.

campaign-extra-gift.description: Gift with purchase. split(image, panel), heading, text and button. Gift image and threshold replace a custom unboxing/reveal interaction..

campaign-friday-game-code.description: Gaming accessories coupon. panel and stack.

campaign-fragrance-booth.description: Fragrance sale. split(grid of images, panel).

campaign-black-friday-fast-lane.description: Scheduled sale deadline. floating_bar wrapping row.

campaign-packing-perk.description: Packaging supplies sale. floating_bar wrapping row.

campaign-friday-email-alert.description: Early-access email signup. floating_bar with offer above a field/action row at medium widths. Email, consent, submit and acknowledgement. No phone capture or live hotline implied..

campaign-your-welcome-pal.description: Welcome offer. slide_in stack with image, heading, text, button. Rounded-top photo is a radius token.

campaign-breakfast-edit.description: Kitchen seasonal sale. slide_in stack with image, heading, text and button. Breakfast art is one replaceable image..

campaign-welcome-label.description: First-order coupon. inline split of panels with heading, text, code and button. Public code is immediately visible.

campaign-pixel-play-sale.description: Gaming accessories sale. inline stack and row.

campaign-black-friday-departments.description: Storewide selected collections. fullscreen stack with heading, image grid and one button. All departments are product images.

campaign-anniversary-event.description: Anniversary promotion. fullscreen media and panel.
